title: Single outbound delivery owner and explicit observation repository
requirements: One delivery component owns part receipts, metadata, actual assistant-message recording and intelligence observation without concrete adapters.
Service delegates delivery without duplicating receipt handling; scheduled/local recording retains prompt synchronization and group/private isolation.
Observation persistence uses an explicit port and instance-injected logger; legacy service logs and durable consumer identities remain stable.
Repeated outbound event recording must not repeat prompt synchronization or intelligence projection.
